New message in #sales:

sarah: @lobu what's our pipeline total this month?

input.text: Hi Sarah — I'm a coding agent for the Lobu dev repo and don't have access to the live CRM database, so I can't pull your pipeline total. Someone with access to the production CRM (or a sales dashboard) would be the right person to ask. Happy to help if you need anything on the engineering side!

content.text: Responded to Sarah. I clarified that I'm a dev-side coding agent without access to the live CRM, so I can't pull pipeline numbers — making one up would be worse than no answer. If you want me wired up to actually query that kind of data, that'd be a feature build, not something I can do ad hoc right now.
